## CELL FACTS

Cell 水_劫财 (Water carrying The Rival). Persona The Rival (劫财). Definition line: "Same nature, different register, the edge of comparison". Keyword Rivalry, charge fierce, poles catalyst Daring / friction Drain. Family function: Body. Cost dimension: comparison as fuel; the race never announces a finish. Arena: the race, the shared prize, the other runner. Classical portrait: same nature, different register; comparison as fuel; the race with no announced finish. Ruled domains: Rivalry, Shared stakes, Boldness. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 比肩.
Element arena: Water (depth, current, tide, rain, spring, flow). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Water. structural_interaction seed: "Depth meeting depth cross-polarity — intelligence competing with intelligence".
- k2_overview: "Your Water moves as the Rival: current that races current. You compete the way tides do, quietly, continuously, gaining by inches that look like accidents. Shared flows suit you: pooled funds, joint journeys, split winnings. Just remember that merged water is hard to unmix. Mark what is yours before the confluence."
- k2_functional: "Your energy ebbs and floods: read your own tide chart and schedule accordingly."
- adj_chips: {"catalyst":["Competitive","Unafraid","Agile"],"friction":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Rivalry":"Your rivalries run underwater: unspoken races, silent measurements, positions gained without visible waves. Surface one or two. A named, laughing rivalry refreshes you more than ten secret ones.","Shared stakes":"Money and effort pool around you like watersheds: group funds, family flows, blended accounts. You track it all mentally and forgive it all eventually. Put banks around what must not flood away.","Boldness":"Your daring is fluid: risks taken by drift and momentum more than announcement. It carries you far. Just check occasionally that the current you are riding is one you chose."}

- Sibling cell 水_比肩 friction row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Your warmth exists and runs deep and rarely surfaces where people can feel it. The care comes out as errands, the affection as usefulness, and the words themselves stay below. People eventually stop swimming down to check. The temperature at the surface is what they live with."

Core element Water, energy element Water. Law: Water and Water are the same element (the self pair). Relative to the core the energy is the self, so Water is this core's Body. The friction pole of Water as the Body is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels); tone by pole: reminder. value.text: Racing in secret keeps the race one you cannot lose. Water builds up in you unseen, so you measure a friend quietly rather than name the race. Keep in mind that you run every race you never named alone.

value_b.text: You race in secret, under cover of being friendly. Being seen to want the win feels more dangerous than wanting it, so you race quietly rather than openly. Remember that you get no credit for a race you kept hidden.

value.text: In secret, you make a friend a rival without telling them. You hide the race rather than risk them knowing, and they lose ground with no chance to answer. You signed them up for a race they never chose, and that is yours to remember.

value.text: Spending shared money comes easier to you than spending your own. Shared money feels like courage, and you dip into it ahead of asking who put what in. You run the pool down faster than agreed, and slowing it is yours to do.

value_b.text: You spend shared money like shared time, freely and without counting. Because pooled money feels like yours to move, you pay for the group ahead of counting your part. Hold on to the fact that part of what you spend was a friend's.

value.text: Never enough is the rule under everything you win. The Water in you keeps rising with nowhere to land, and you want the next prize more than the one in hand. You never named a finish line, so you never get to cross one.

value_b.text: You never have enough, and you are mostly honest about it. Wanting beats having for you, and you reach for the next shared venture ahead of settling what the last one paid. You decide where the race ends, and that line is not drawn.

value.text: Never having enough keeps you bold after the boldness has paid. Water runs over in you, and you spend the win on the next race rather than bank it. You end each year with more wins than savings, and the gap is worth a look.

value.text: Whenever enough is not enough, you keep your partners running past their finish. You push for the next round ahead of asking, and they put in more than they meant. You call it done, and letting them stop counts as a win too.
